intro: Spatial design, Blueprint gameplay implementation, and Unreal tools for designers.
homeBackground: I’m a level and gameplay designer with five years of professional experience. At Virtuos, I worked on single-player levels and character abilities; on Honor of Kings: World, I worked on mission gameplay. I also build Unreal tools for level editing and inspection.

about: I’ve worked on DLC levels and abilities for Marvel’s Midnight Suns, mission gameplay for Honor of Kings: World, and level scripting and event-inspection tools for an FPS remake. I also build personal prototypes to explore gameplay rules and level editing.
approach: I start by deciding what the player should do and notice, then work out the space, interactions, and rules. In the engine, I get the flow playable, check edge cases, and work with programmers and artists to resolve production issues.

aboutFocus.title: Combat spaces
aboutFocus.text: In Midnight Suns, I used explosives, stun interactions, and fall zones to give players tactical options. Before building a level, I worked through the combat areas, sightlines, and connecting spaces on paper.

aboutFocus.title: Mission gameplay
aboutFocus.text: Mission photography needed familiar photo controls and task-specific success checks. I used a feature allowlist to define what to reuse, then specified activation, target display, and completion and exit handling.

aboutFocus.title: Ability implementation
aboutFocus.text: For DLC abilities, I connected Blueprints, animation, effects, and UI into a flow from target selection to completion, then used breakpoints to resolve movement, target-filtering, and state issues.

aboutFocus.title: Level tools
aboutFocus.text: When legacy events were difficult to inspect, I worked with a programmer on a script parser and visualization tool. For Sokoban, I built an editor for painting, validating, and saving levels so they could be authored without editing data arrays by hand.

experience.description: Designed photo-based mission gameplay for Honor of Kings: World, documented requirements, and coordinated UI, motion, and audio work for a countdown feature.
Built DLC levels and abilities for Marvel’s Midnight Suns, and worked on level scripting and designer tools for an FPS remake.
